title: circEIF3I facilitates the recruitment of SMAD3 to early endosomes to promote TGF-beta signalling pathway-mediated activation of MMPs in pancreatic cancer.
authors: Zhao, Zhongjie; Yang, Wenbo; Kong, Rui; Zhang, Yangyang; Li, Le; Song, Zengfu; Chen, Hongze; Luo, Yan; Zhang, Tao; Cheng, Chundong; Li, Guanqun; Liu, Danxi; Geng, Xinglong; Chen, Hua; Wang, Yongwei; Pan, Shangha; Hu, Jisheng; Sun, Bei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究circEIF3I作为分子支架促进SMAD3与TGFβRI在早期内体互作激活TGF-β通路，虽涉及RNA-蛋白互作和模拟分析，但核心是circRNA-蛋白而非TF-DNA体系，且方法以湿实验为主，仅少量RNA-蛋白互作模拟，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Among digestive tract tumours, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) shows the highest mortality trend. Moreover, although PDAC metastasis remains a leading cause of cancer-related deaths, the biological mechanism is poorly understood. Recent evidence demonstrates that circular RNAs (circRNAs) play important roles in PDAC progression. METHODS: Differentially expressed circRNAs in normal and PDAC tissues were screened via bioinformatics analysis. Sanger sequencing, RNase R and actinomycin D assays were performed to confirm the loop structure of circEIF3I. In vitro and in vivo functional experiments were conducted to assess the role of circEIF3I in PDAC. MS2-tagged RNA affinity purification, mass spectrometry, RNA immunoprecipitation, RNA pull-down assay, fluorescence in situ hybridization, immunofluorescence and RNA-protein interaction simulation and analysis were performed to identify circEIF3I-interacting proteins. The effects of circEIF3I on the interactions of SMAD3 with TGFbetaRI or AP2A1 were measured through co-immunoprecipitation and western blotting. RESULTS: A microarray data analysis showed that circEIF3I was highly expressed in PDAC cells and correlated with TNM stage and poor prognosis. Functional experiments in vitro and in vivo revealed that circEIF3I accelerated PDAC cells migration, invasion and metastasis by increasing MMPs expression and activity. Mechanistic research indicated that circEIF3I binds to the MH2 domain of SMAD3 and increases SMAD3 phosphorylation by strengthening the interactions between SMAD3 and TGFbetaRI on early endosomes. Moreover, AP2A1 binds with circEIF3I directly and promotes circEIF3I-bound SMAD3 recruitment to TGFbetaRI on early endosomes. Finally, we found that circEif3i exerts biological functions in mice similar to those of circEIF3I in humans PDAC. CONCLUSIONS: Our study reveals that circEIF3I promotes pancreatic cancer progression. circEIF3I is a molecular scaffold that interacts with SMAD3 and AP2A1 to form a ternary complex, that facilitates the recruitment of SMAD3 to early endosomes and then activates the TGF-beta signalling pathway. Hence, circEIF3I is a potential prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in PDAC.
abstract_zh: 背景：在消化道肿瘤中，胰腺导管腺癌（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC）显示出最高的死亡率趋势。此外，尽管PDAC转移仍是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，但其生物学机制尚不清楚。近期证据表明，环状RNA（circular RNAs, circRNAs）在PDAC进展中发挥重要作用。方法：通过生物信息学分析筛选正常组织和PDAC组织中差异表达的circRNAs。采用Sanger测序、RNase R和放线菌素D实验确认circEIF3I的环状结构。进行体外和体内功能实验以评估circEIF3I在PDAC中的作用。采用MS2标记RNA亲和纯化、质谱分析、RNA免疫沉淀、RNA pull-down实验、荧光原位杂交、免疫荧光以及RNA-蛋白质相互作用模拟与分析，以鉴定与circEIF3I相互作用的蛋白质。通过共免疫沉淀和western blotting检测circEIF3I对SMAD3与TGFbetaRI或AP2A1相互作用的影响。结果：微阵列数据分析显示，circEIF3I在PDAC细胞中高表达，并与TNM分期和不良预后相关。体外和体内功能实验表明，circEIF3I通过增加MMPs表达和活性，加速PDAC细胞的迁移、侵袭和转移。机制研究表明，circEIF3I与SMAD3的MH2结构域结合，并通过增强早期内体上SMAD3与TGFbetaRI的相互作用，增加SMAD3磷酸化。此外，AP2A1直接与circEIF3I结合，并促进与circEIF3I结合的SMAD3在早期内体上被招募至TGFbetaRI。最后，我们发现circEif3i在小鼠中发挥的生物学功能与circEIF3I在人类PDAC中的功能相似。结论：我们的研究揭示circEIF3I促进胰腺癌进展。circEIF3I是一个分子支架，与SMAD3和AP2A1相互作用形成三元复合物，促进SMAD3招募至早期内体，进而激活TGF-beta信号通路。因此，circEIF3I是PDAC中潜在的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。
